blurb: Haribhadra's compact manual of the Jaina way of life, in eight adhyāyas of terse sūtras. It moves from the general duties of a householder to the special vows, the fitness for and discipline of ascetic life, and the fruits of dharma up to liberation. It is read here with the full vṛtti of Municandrasūri.
about: Haribhadra opens with a verse promising a bindu, a drop drawn from the ocean of scripture, and defines dharma as conduct that follows the uncontradicted word of the Jina and is joined with maitrī and the other three attitudes. He then divides it into the dharma of the householder and that of the ascetic. Adhyāyas 1–3 treat householder dharma in its general and special forms, including the aṇuvratas, guṇavratas and śikṣāpadas with their transgressions. Adhyāyas 4–6 treat renunciation and the life of the ascetic, and adhyāyas 7–8 the fruit of dharma.

Municandrasūri's vṛtti opens each sūtra with a short lead-in, which the reader shows above the sūtra's commentary. It then glosses the sūtra word by word and supports it with verses cited from Jaina and Brahmanical sources.

Suali's Bibliotheca Indica edition was begun in 1908, stalled after 1921, and completed by Chintaharan Chakravarti in 1940. It counts the opening and closing verses of each adhyāya as sūtras and prints the closing iti apart from the sūtra, unlike the 1924 Ahmedabad edition. Where the printed sūtra number in this text is a slip, the reader numbers the sūtras in sequence and notes the printed number.

items.text: Dr. Luigi Suali of Bologna (Italy) who edited the Saddarasana Samuccaya of Haribhadrasuri for the Society in the Bibliothcca Indica Series was entrusted in 1908 with the work of editing the Dharmabindu of the same author with Municandra's commentary. The Sanskrit text of the entire work prepared by Dr. Suali was received by the Society from him and the first fascicle comprising pp. 1-80 was printed in 1912. During the following eight years no further progress was made, but in 1921 the work was resumed and pages 113-160 were sent to the press and Dr. Suali corrected them up to the stage of page-proof. There was a hiatus again in the progress of the work for which no apparent reason can be assigned. In 1939 when the re- organization of the work of the Society was taken in hand and publication of all works that were lying incomplete was under- taken—all efforts to get in touch with Dr. Suali having failed- Prof. Chintaharan Chakravarti was entrusted by the Council with the task of seeing the materials left by Dr. Suali through the press and bringing the long delayed work to completion.

In the absence of the Sanskrit text, published for the first time by Dr. Suali in the Giornala della Societa, Asiatica Italiana with Italian translation (Vol. 21, pp. 223 ff.), it was not possible to check the press copy left by Dr. Suali with the printed Sanskrit text and ascertain how it was prepared. From the footnotes where variants have been recorded, it appears that Dr. Suali's text was made from four different MSS. though no details are available as regards the latter. Prof. Chakravarti has, however, been able to compare the text, now printed, with a MS. of the work in the possession of the Society, and a printed edition recently published from Ahmedabad. In addition, he has given a short introduction, a table of contents and a list of important words occurring in the work.

It is hoped that the work, which is an important document of Jaina philosophy now published in a completed form after thirty years from the time of its inception, and unhappily not fully seen through the press by the distinguished editor, will, nevertheless, serve to satisfy a keenly-felt want of students of Indian and specially of Jaina philosophy and doctrine of life.

B. S. GUHA,
General Secretary,
Royal Asiatic Society of Bengal.
The Dharmabindu of Haribhadra is an important Jaina work on the rules of life of both the layman and the ascetic. Incidentally it gives the Jaina view of the summum bonum of life.

The work appears to have been published for the first time with an Italian translation by Dr. Suali, the editor of the present work, in the pages of the Giornala della Societa Asiatica Italiana (Vol. 21, pp. 223 ff.). Though the present edition was undertaken as far back as the year 1908 and one fascich was issued in 1912, the complete edition with the commentary of Municandra now published, cannot lay claim to its being published for the first time in this country, as an edition in the orthodox style in what is called Pothi form (with loose leaves) from Ahmedabad (inadvertently referred to as Surat in the footnotes of pages 236 and 237) was published in 1924. The Ahmedabad edition does not refer to the already published fascicle of the Bibliotheca Indica edition or to any manuscripts on which the edition is based. It has three indices:-

(1) List of the sutras arranged serially.
(2) List of the sūtras arranged alphabetically.
(3) Alphabetical list of verses quoted in the commentary.

The present edition is based on five manuscripts, of which no details are known, collated by Dr. Suali (indicated as A, B, C, D, and P) and one manuscript belonging to the Royal Asiatic Society of Bengal (indicated as R) and collated by the under- signed who also compared the Ahmedabad edition for the portion of the work published under his supervision.
It is of interest to note that very few important variants were noticed either in the manuscript or the Ahmedabad edition.
It is also curious that none of the MSS. seems to contain the name of the author.

It is to be mentioned that the present edition differs from the Ahmedabad one in the numbering of and reckoning of, the extent of the individual sutras. The latter does not count as sūtras the verses occurring at the beginning and end of each chapter and they are distinguished from the sutras by a separate numbering. Also the word iti occurring at the end of each sutra is taken in it to be a part of the sutra itself while in the present edition it has been systematically separated from the sutras. The same remark applies to introductory words like tathā. Attention has been drawn to two instances of the latter type in the footnotes on pages 236 and 237.
A. egards auxiliary matters a list of contents and a glossary of peculiar terms used in the sutras have been added.

t.deva:
धनदो धनार्थिनां प्रोक्तः कामिनां सर्वकामदः।
धर्म एवापवर्गस्य पारंपर्येण साधकः॥२॥
t.iast:

t.deva:
अथामुमेव धर्मं भेदतः प्रभेदतश्च बिभणिषुराह।
सोऽयमनुष्ठातृभेदाद्द्विविधो गृहस्थधर्मो यतिधर्मश्च॥४॥
t.iast:
athāmumeva dharmaṃ bhedataḥ prabhedataśca bibhaṇiṣurāha |
so'yamanuṣṭhātṛbhedāddvividho gṛhasthadharmo yatidharmaśca ‖ 4 ‖

sō’yamanuṣṭhātr̥bhēdāddvividhō gr̥hasthadharmō yatidharmaśca ‖ 4 ‖

rohanti vidhinoptāni yathā bījāni satkṣitau ‖ 1 ‖

t.deva:

tathā saddharmabījānāmapātreṣu vidurbudhāḥ ‖ 2 ‖

bījanāśō yathābhūmau prarōhō vēha niṣphalaḥ |
tathā saddharmabījānāmapātrēṣu vidurbudhāḥ ‖ 2 ‖

bIjanAzo yathAbhUmau praroho veha niSphalaH |
tathA saddharmabIjAnAmapAtreSu vidurbudhAH ‖ 2 ‖

na sādhayati yaḥ samyagajñaḥ svalpaṃ cikīrṣitam |

t.iso:

t.deva:

तत्त्वेन तेन च प्रत्याख्यानं ज्ञात्वा सुबह्वपि॥३॥
t.iast:

tattvena tena ca pratyAkhyAnaM jJAtvA subahvapi ‖ 3 ‖

t.deva: इति विशेषतो गृहस्थधर्म उक्तः। सांप्रतं यतिधर्मावसर इति यतिमनुवर्णयिष्यामः॥४॥
t.iast: iti viśeṣato gṛhasthadharma uktaḥ | sāṃprataṃ yatidharmāvasara iti yatimanuvarṇayiṣyāmaḥ ‖ 4 ‖
t.iso: iti viśēṣatō gr̥hasthadharma uktaḥ | sāṁprataṁ yatidharmāvasara iti yatimanuvarṇayiṣyāmaḥ ‖ 4 ‖
t.hk: iti vizeSato gRhasthadharma uktaH | sAMprataM yatidharmAvasara iti yatimanuvarNayiSyAmaH ‖ 4 ‖

t.deva:
अथ प्रव्रज्यार्ह। आर्यदेशोत्पन्नो विशिष्टजातिकुलान्वितः क्षीणप्रायकर्ममलः। तत एव विमलबुद्धिः। दुर्लभं मानुष्यं जन्ममरणनिमित्तं संपदश्चपला विषया दुःखहेतवः संयोगे वियोगः प्रति-
क्षणं मरणं दारुणो विपाक इत्यवगतसंसारनैर्गुण्यः। तत एव तद्विरक्तः प्रतनुकषायोऽल्पहास्यादिः कृतज्ञो विनीतः प्रागपि राजामात्यपौरजन- बहुमतोऽद्रोहकारी कल्याणाङ्गः श्राद्धः स्थिरः समुपसंपन्नश्च॥६॥
t.iast:
atha pravrajyārha | āryadeśotpanno viśiṣṭajātikulānvitaḥ kṣīṇaprāyakarmamalaḥ | tata eva vimalabuddhiḥ | durlabhaṃ mānuṣyaṃ janmamaraṇanimittaṃ saṃpadaścapalā viṣayā duḥkhahetavaḥ saṃyoge viyogaḥ prati-
kṣaṇaṃ maraṇaṃ dāruṇo vipāka ityavagatasaṃsāranairguṇyaḥ | tata eva tadviraktaḥ pratanukaṣāyo'lpahāsyādiḥ kṛtajño vinītaḥ prāgapi rājāmātyapaurajana- bahumato'drohakārī kalyāṇāṅgaḥ śrāddhaḥ sthiraḥ samupasaṃpannaśca ‖ 6 ‖
t.iso:
atha pravrajyārha | āryadēśōtpannō viśiṣṭajātikulānvitaḥ kṣīṇaprāyakarmamalaḥ | tata ēva vimalabuddhiḥ | durlabhaṁ mānuṣyaṁ janmamaraṇanimittaṁ saṁpadaścapalā viṣayā duḥkhahētavaḥ saṁyōgē viyōgaḥ prati-
kṣaṇaṁ maraṇaṁ dāruṇō vipāka ityavagatasaṁsāranairguṇyaḥ | tata ēva tadviraktaḥ pratanukaṣāyō’lpahāsyādiḥ kr̥tajñō vinītaḥ prāgapi rājāmātyapaurajana- bahumatō’drōhakārī kalyāṇāṅgaḥ śrāddhaḥ sthiraḥ samupasaṁpannaśca ‖ 6 ‖
t.hk:
atha pravrajyArha | Aryadezotpanno viziSTajAtikulAnvitaH kSINaprAyakarmamalaH | tata eva vimalabuddhiH | durlabhaM mAnuSyaM janmamaraNanimittaM saMpadazcapalA viSayA duHkhahetavaH saMyoge viyogaH prati-
kSaNaM maraNaM dAruNo vipAka ityavagatasaMsAranairguNyaH | tata eva tadviraktaH pratanukaSAyo'lpahAsyAdiH kRtajJo vinItaH prAgapi rAjAmAtyapaurajana- bahumato'drohakArI kalyANAGgaH zrAddhaH sthiraH samupasaMpannazca ‖ 6 ‖

t.deva: गुरुपदार्हस्त्वित्थंभूत एव। विधिप्रतिपन्नप्रव्रर्ज्यः समुपासितगुरुकुलः अस्खलितशीलः सम्यगधीतागमः तत एव विमलतरबोधात्तववेदीं उप- शान्तः प्रवचनवत्सलः सत्त्वहितरतः आदेयः अनुवर्तकः गम्भीरः अविषादौ उपशमलब्ध्यादिसंपन्नः प्रवचनार्थवक्ता स्वगुर्वतुज्ञातगुरुपदश्चेति॥७॥
t.iast: gurupadārhastvitthaṃbhūta eva | vidhipratipannapravrarjyaḥ samupāsitagurukulaḥ askhalitaśīlaḥ samyagadhītāgamaḥ tata eva vimalatarabodhāttavavedīṃ upa- śāntaḥ pravacanavatsalaḥ sattvahitarataḥ ādeyaḥ anuvartakaḥ gambhīraḥ aviṣādau upaśamalabdhyādisaṃpannaḥ pravacanārthavaktā svagurvatujñātagurupadaśceti ‖ 7 ‖
t.iso: gurupadārhastvitthaṁbhūta ēva | vidhipratipannapravrarjyaḥ samupāsitagurukulaḥ askhalitaśīlaḥ samyagadhītāgamaḥ tata ēva vimalatarabōdhāttavavēdīṁ upa- śāntaḥ pravacanavatsalaḥ sattvahitarataḥ ādēyaḥ anuvartakaḥ gambhīraḥ aviṣādau upaśamalabdhyādisaṁpannaḥ pravacanārthavaktā svagurvatujñātagurupadaścēti ‖ 7 ‖
t.hk: gurupadArhastvitthaMbhUta eva | vidhipratipannapravrarjyaH samupAsitagurukulaH askhalitazIlaH samyagadhItAgamaH tata eva vimalatarabodhAttavavedIM upa- zAntaH pravacanavatsalaH sattvahitarataH AdeyaH anuvartakaH gambhIraH aviSAdau upazamalabdhyAdisaMpannaH pravacanArthavaktA svagurvatujJAtagurupadazceti ‖ 7 ‖

ग्लानौषधादिज्ञातात्त्यागः॥३४॥

एवं यः शुद्धयोगेन परित्यज्य गृहाश्रमम्।
संयमे रमते नित्यं स यतिः परिकीर्तितः॥४७॥

अनुपायात्तु साध्यस्य सिद्धिं नेच्छन्ति पण्डिताः॥४८॥

anupāyāttu sādhyasya siddhiṃ necchanti paṇḍitāḥ ‖ 48 ‖

colophon.iast: iti śrīmunicandrasūriviracitāyāṃ dharmabinduvṛttau yatidharmavidhiḥ pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ‖ 5 ‖

t.deva:
बाहुभ्यां दुस्तरो यद्वत्क्रूरनक्रो महोदधिः।
यतित्वं दुष्करं तद्वदित्याहुस्तत्त्ववेदिनः॥१॥
t.iast:
bāhubhyāṃ dustaro yadvatkrūranakro mahodadhiḥ |
yatitvaṃ duṣkaraṃ tadvadityāhustattvavedinaḥ ‖ 1 ‖

yatitvaṁ duṣkaraṁ tadvadityāhustattvavēdinaḥ ‖ 1 ‖

yatitvaM duSkaraM tadvadityAhustattvavedinaH ‖ 1 ‖

t.deva:
अस्यैव दुष्करत्वे हेतुमाह।
अपवर्गः फलं यस्य जन्ममृत्यादिवर्जितः।
परमानन्दरूपश्च दुष्करं तन्न चाद्भुतम्॥२॥
t.iast:
asyaiva duṣkaratve hetumāha |
apavargaḥ phalaṃ yasya janmamṛtyādivarjitaḥ |
paramānandarūpaśca duṣkaraṃ tanna cādbhutam ‖ 2 ‖
t.iso:

t.hk:

पण्डए वार कीवे कुम्भी ईसालुयत्तिय।
सउणी तक्वम्मसेवी य पक्तियापक्तिए इय॥
सोगन्धिए य आसत्ते एए दस नपुंसगा।
संकिलट्ठन्ति साहूणं पव्वावेउं अकप्पिया॥
एतत्स्वरूपं च निशीथाध्ययना ज्ज्ञातव्यम्॥
उचितेऽनुज्ञापना॥३४॥
t.iast:
paṇḍae vāra kīve kumbhī īsāluyattiya |
saüṇī takvammasevī ya paktiyāpaktie iya ‖
sogandhie ya āsatte ee dasa napuṃsagā |
saṃkilaṭṭhanti sāhūṇaṃ pavvāveuṃ akappiyā ‖
etatsvarūpaṃ ca niśīthādhyayanā jjñātavyam ‖
ucite'nujñāpanā ‖ 34 ‖
t.iso:
paṇḍaē vāra kīvē kumbhī īsāluyattiya |
sa:uṇī takvammasēvī ya paktiyāpaktiē iya ‖
sōgandhiē ya āsattē ēē dasa napuṁsagā |
saṁkilaṭṭhanti sāhūṇaṁ pavvāvēuṁ akappiyā ‖
ētatsvarūpaṁ ca niśīthādhyayanā jjñātavyam ‖
ucitē’nujñāpanā ‖ 34 ‖
t.hk:
paNDae vAra kIve kumbhI IsAluyattiya |
sa_uNI takvammasevI ya paktiyApaktie iya ‖
sogandhie ya Asatte ee dasa napuMsagA |
saMkilaTThanti sAhUNaM pavvAveuM akappiyA ‖
etatsvarUpaM ca nizIthAdhyayanA jjJAtavyam ‖
ucite'nujJApanA ‖ 34 ‖

t.deva:
एवं च गृहीतस्य किं कार्यमित्याह।
गुरोर्निवेदनम्॥३८॥
t.iast:
evaṃ ca gṛhītasya kiṃ kāryamityāha |
gurornivedanam ‖ 38 ‖
t.iso:
ēvaṁ ca gr̥hītasya kiṁ kāryamityāha |
gurōrnivēdanam ‖ 38 ‖
t.hk:
evaM ca gRhItasya kiM kAryamityAha |
gurornivedanam ‖ 38 ‖

t.deva:
सम्यग्यतित्वमाराध्य महात्मानो यथोदितम्।
संप्राप्नुवन्ति कल्याणमिह लोके परत्र च॥१०२॥
t.iast:
samyagyatitvamārādhya mahātmāno yathoditam |
saṃprāpnuvanti kalyāṇamiha loke paratra ca ‖ 102 ‖
t.iso:
samyagyatitvamārādhya mahātmānō yathōditam |
saṁprāpnuvanti kalyāṇamiha lōkē paratra ca ‖ 102 ‖
t.hk:
samyagyatitvamArAdhya mahAtmAno yathoditam |
saMprApnuvanti kalyANamiha loke paratra ca ‖ 102 ‖

colophon.deva: इति श्रीमुभिचन्द्रसूरिविरचितायां धर्मबिन्दुवृत्तौ द्यति धर्मविषयविधिः षष्ठोऽध्यायः समाप्तः॥६॥
colophon.iast: iti śrīmubhicandrasūriviracitāyāṃ dharmabinduvṛttau dyati dharmaviṣayavidhiḥ ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ‖ 6 ‖

t.deva:
आशयाद्युचितं ज्यायोऽनुष्ठानं सूरयो विदुः।
साध्यसिद्ध्यङ्गमित्यस्माद्यतिधर्मो द्विधा मतः॥१॥
t.iast:
āśayādyucitaṃ jyāyo'nuṣṭhānaṃ sūrayo viduḥ |
sādhyasiddhyaṅgamityasmādyatidharmo dvidhā mataḥ ‖ 1 ‖
t.iso:
āśayādyucitaṁ jyāyō’nuṣṭhānaṁ sūrayō viduḥ |
sādhyasiddhyaṅgamityasmādyatidharmō dvidhā mataḥ ‖ 1 ‖
t.hk:
AzayAdyucitaM jyAyo'nuSThAnaM sUrayo viduH |
sAdhyasiddhyaGgamityasmAdyatidharmo dvidhA mataH ‖ 1 ‖

t.deva: दवीयसापि कालेन वैकल्ये तु न जातुचित्॥२॥
t.iast: davīyasāpi kālena vaikalye tu na jātucit ‖ 2 ‖
t.iso: davīyasāpi kālēna vaikalyē tu na jātucit ‖ 2 ‖
t.hk: davIyasApi kAlena vaikalye tu na jAtucit ‖ 2 ‖

t.deva:
तस्माद्यो यस्य योग्यः स्यात्तत्तेनालोच्य सर्वथा।
आरब्धव्यमुपायेन सम्यगेष सतां नयः॥३॥
t.iast:
tasmādyo yasya yogyaḥ syāttattenālocya sarvathā |
ārabdhavyamupāyena samyageṣa satāṃ nayaḥ ‖ 3 ‖
t.iso:
tasmādyō yasya yōgyaḥ syāttattēnālōcya sarvathā |
ārabdhavyamupāyēna samyagēṣa satāṁ nayaḥ ‖ 3 ‖
t.hk:
tasmAdyo yasya yogyaH syAttattenAlocya sarvathA |
ArabdhavyamupAyena samyageSa satAM nayaH ‖ 3 ‖

t.deva: तत्र कल्याणाशयस्य श्रुतरत्नमहोदधेः उपशमादिलब्धिमतः पर हितोद्यतस्य अत्यन्तगम्भीरचेतसः प्रधानपरिणतेः विधूतमोहस्य परमसत्त्वार्थकर्तुः सामायिकवतः विशुद्ध्यमानाशयस्य यथोचितप्रवृत्तेः सात्मीभूतशुभयोगस्य श्रेयान् सापेक्षयतिधर्म एव॥५॥
t.iast: tatra kalyāṇāśayasya śrutaratnamahodadheḥ upaśamādilabdhimataḥ para hitodyatasya atyantagambhīracetasaḥ pradhānapariṇateḥ vidhūtamohasya paramasattvārthakartuḥ sāmāyikavataḥ viśuddhyamānāśayasya yathocitapravṛtteḥ sātmībhūtaśubhayogasya śreyān sāpekṣayatidharma eva ‖ 5 ‖
t.iso: tatra kalyāṇāśayasya śrutaratnamahōdadhēḥ upaśamādilabdhimataḥ para hitōdyatasya atyantagambhīracētasaḥ pradhānapariṇatēḥ vidhūtamōhasya paramasattvārthakartuḥ sāmāyikavataḥ viśuddhyamānāśayasya yathōcitapravr̥ttēḥ sātmībhūtaśubhayōgasya śrēyān sāpēkṣayatidharma ēva ‖ 5 ‖
t.hk: tatra kalyANAzayasya zrutaratnamahodadheH upazamAdilabdhimataH para hitodyatasya atyantagambhIracetasaH pradhAnapariNateH vidhUtamohasya paramasattvArthakartuH sAmAyikavataH vizuddhyamAnAzayasya yathocitapravRtteH sAtmIbhUtazubhayogasya zreyAn sApekSayatidharma eva ‖ 5 ‖

var: Numbering jumps from 8 to 10 in the edition

t.deva:
नवादिपूर्वधरस्य तु यथोदितगुणस्यापि साधुशिष्यनिष्पत्तौ साध्यान्तंराभावतः सति कायादि-
सामर्थ्ये सद्वीर्याचारासेवनेन तथा प्रमादजयाय सम्यगुचितसमय आज्ञाप्रामाण्यतस्तथैव योगवृद्धेः प्रायोपवेशनवच्छ्रेयान्निरपेक्षयतिधर्मः॥१४॥
t.iast:
navādipūrvadharasya tu yathoditaguṇasyāpi sādhuśiṣyaniṣpattau sādhyāntaṃrābhāvataḥ sati kāyādi-
sāmarthye sadvīryācārāsevanena tathā pramādajayāya samyagucitasamaya ājñāprāmāṇyatastathaiva yogavṛddheḥ prāyopaveśanavacchreyānnirapekṣayatidharmaḥ ‖ 14 ‖
t.iso:
navādipūrvadharasya tu yathōditaguṇasyāpi sādhuśiṣyaniṣpattau sādhyāntaṁrābhāvataḥ sati kāyādi-
sāmarthyē sadvīryācārāsēvanēna tathā pramādajayāya samyagucitasamaya ājñāprāmāṇyatastathaiva yōgavr̥ddhēḥ prāyōpavēśanavacchrēyānnirapēkṣayatidharmaḥ ‖ 14 ‖
t.hk:
navAdipUrvadharasya tu yathoditaguNasyApi sAdhuziSyaniSpattau sAdhyAntaMrAbhAvataH sati kAyAdi-
sAmarthye sadvIryAcArAsevanena tathA pramAdajayAya samyagucitasamaya AjJAprAmANyatastathaiva yogavRddheH prAyopavezanavacchreyAnnirapekSayatidharmaH ‖ 14 ‖

t.deva: न हि श्रुतमय्या प्रज्ञया भावनादृष्टज्ञातं ज्ञातं नाम॥३४॥
t.iast: na hi śrutamayyā prajñayā bhāvanādṛṣṭajñātaṃ jñātaṃ nāma ‖ 34 ‖
t.iso: na hi śrutamayyā prajñayā bhāvanādr̥ṣṭajñātaṁ jñātaṁ nāma ‖ 34 ‖
t.hk: na hi zrutamayyA prajJayA bhAvanAdRSTajJAtaM jJAtaM nAma ‖ 34 ‖

t.deva: तद्वन्तो हि दृष्टापाययोगेऽप्यदृष्टापायेभ्यो निवर्तमाना दृश्यन्त एवान्यरक्षादाविति॥३९॥
t.iast: tadvanto hi dṛṣṭāpāyayoge'pyadṛṣṭāpāyebhyo nivartamānā dṛśyanta evānyarakṣādāviti ‖ 39 ‖
t.iso: tadvantō hi dr̥ṣṭāpāyayōgē’pyadr̥ṣṭāpāyēbhyō nivartamānā dr̥śyanta ēvānyarakṣādāviti ‖ 39 ‖
t.hk: tadvanto hi dRSTApAyayoge'pyadRSTApAyebhyo nivartamAnA dRzyanta evAnyarakSAdAviti ‖ 39 ‖

t.deva: इति मुमुक्षोः सर्वत्र भावनायामेव यत्नः श्रेयान्॥४०॥
t.iast: iti mumukṣoḥ sarvatra bhāvanāyāmeva yatnaḥ śreyān ‖ 40 ‖
t.iso: iti mumukṣōḥ sarvatra bhāvanāyāmēva yatnaḥ śrēyān ‖ 40 ‖
t.hk: iti mumukSoH sarvatra bhAvanAyAmeva yatnaH zreyAn ‖ 40 ‖

t.deva: एवं च प्रायो भगवत एव चेतसि समवस्थानम्॥४६॥
t.iast: evaṃ ca prāyo bhagavata eva cetasi samavasthānam ‖ 46 ‖
t.iso: ēvaṁ ca prāyō bhagavata ēva cētasi samavasthānam ‖ 46 ‖
t.hk: evaM ca prAyo bhagavata eva cetasi samavasthAnam ‖ 46 ‖

t.deva:
यदि नौत्सुक्यं प्रवृत्तिकालसाधनं तर्हि किं साधनमित्यप्शङ्क्यह ।
प्रभूतान्येव तु प्रवृत्तिकालसाधनानि॥६२॥
t.iast:
yadi nautsukyaṃ pravṛttikālasādhanaṃ tarhi kiṃ sādhanamityapśaṅkyaha  |
prabhūtānyeva tu pravṛttikālasādhanāni ‖ 62 ‖
t.iso:
yadi nautsukyaṁ pravr̥ttikālasādhanaṁ tarhi kiṁ sādhanamityapśaṅkyaha  |
prabhūtānyēva tu pravr̥ttikālasādhanāni ‖ 62 ‖
t.hk:
yadi nautsukyaM pravRttikAlasAdhanaM tarhi kiM sAdhanamityapzaGkyaha  |
prabhUtAnyeva tu pravRttikAlasAdhanAni ‖ 62 ‖

t.deva:
एवंविधयतेः प्रायो भावशुद्धेर्महात्मनः।
विनिवृत्ताग्रहस्योच्चैर्मोक्षतुल्यो भवोऽपि हि॥८०॥
t.iast:
evaṃvidhayateḥ prāyo bhāvaśuddhermahātmanaḥ |
vinivṛttāgrahasyoccairmokṣatulyo bhavo'pi hi ‖ 80 ‖
t.iso:
ēvaṁvidhayatēḥ prāyō bhāvaśuddhērmahātmanaḥ |
vinivr̥ttāgrahasyōccairmōkṣatulyō bhavō’pi hi ‖ 80 ‖
t.hk:
evaMvidhayateH prAyo bhAvazuddhermahAtmanaH |
vinivRttAgrahasyoccairmokSatulyo bhavo'pi hi ‖ 80 ‖

colophon.deva: इति श्रीमुनिचन्द्रसुरिविरचितायां धर्मबिन्दुवृत्तौ धर्मफलविधिः सप्तमोऽध्यायः समाप्तः॥७॥
colophon.iast: iti śrīmunicandrasuriviracitāyāṃ dharmabinduvṛttau dharmaphalavidhiḥ saptamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ‖ 7 ‖

t.deva:
प्रवृत्त्यङ्गमदः श्रेष्ठं सत्त्वानां प्रायशश्च यत्।
आदौ सर्वत्र तद्युक्तमभिधातुमिदं पुनः॥२॥
t.iast:
pravṛttyaṅgamadaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ sattvānāṃ prāyaśaśca yat |
ādau sarvatra tadyuktamabhidhātumidaṃ punaḥ ‖ 2 ‖
t.iso:
pravr̥ttyaṅgamadaḥ śrēṣṭhaṁ sattvānāṁ prāyaśaśca yat |
ādau sarvatra tadyuktamabhidhātumidaṁ punaḥ ‖ 2 ‖
t.hk:
pravRttyaGgamadaH zreSThaM sattvAnAM prAyazazca yat |
Adau sarvatra tadyuktamabhidhAtumidaM punaH ‖ 2 ‖

t.deva:
विशिष्टं देवसौख्यं यच्छिवसौख्यं च यत्परम्।
धर्मकल्पद्रुमस्येदं फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥३॥
t.iast:
viśiṣṭaṃ devasaukhyaṃ yacchivasaukhyaṃ ca yatparam |
dharmakalpadrumasyedaṃ phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ‖ 3 ‖
t.iso:
viśiṣṭaṁ dēvasaukhyaṁ yacchivasaukhyaṁ ca yatparam |
dharmakalpadrumasyēdaṁ phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ‖ 3 ‖
t.hk:
viziSTaM devasaukhyaM yacchivasaukhyaM ca yatparam |
dharmakalpadrumasyedaM phalamAhurmanISiNaH ‖ 3 ‖

t.deva:
तत्रोत्तमा रूपसंपत् सत्स्थितिप्रभावसुखद्युतिलेश्यायोगो विशुद्धेन्द्रियविधित्वं प्रकृष्टानि भोगसाधनानि दिव्यो विमाननिवहो मनोहराण्युद्यात्रानि रम्या जलाशयाः कान्ता अप्सरसो-
ऽतिनिपुणाः किंकराः प्रगल्भो नाट्यविधिश्चतुरोदारा भोगाः सदा चित्ताह्लादोऽनेकसुखहेतुत्वं कुशलानुबन्धो महाकल्याणपूजाकरणं तौर्थकरसेवा सद्धर्मश्रुतौ रतिः सदा सुखित्वम्॥११॥
t.iast:
tatrottamā rūpasaṃpat satsthitiprabhāvasukhadyutileśyāyogo viśuddhendriyavidhitvaṃ prakṛṣṭāni bhogasādhanāni divyo vimānanivaho manoharāṇyudyātrāni ramyā jalāśayāḥ kāntā apsaraso-
'tinipuṇāḥ kiṃkarāḥ pragalbho nāṭyavidhiścaturodārā bhogāḥ sadā cittāhlādo'nekasukhahetutvaṃ kuśalānubandho mahākalyāṇapūjākaraṇaṃ taurthakarasevā saddharmaśrutau ratiḥ sadā sukhitvam ‖ 11 ‖
t.iso:
tatrōttamā rūpasaṁpat satsthitiprabhāvasukhadyutilēśyāyōgō viśuddhēndriyavidhitvaṁ prakr̥ṣṭāni bhōgasādhanāni divyō vimānanivahō manōharāṇyudyātrāni ramyā jalāśayāḥ kāntā apsarasō-
’tinipuṇāḥ kiṁkarāḥ pragalbhō nāṭyavidhiścaturōdārā bhōgāḥ sadā cittāhlādō’nēkasukhahētutvaṁ kuśalānubandhō mahākalyāṇapūjākaraṇaṁ taurthakarasēvā saddharmaśrutau ratiḥ sadā sukhitvam ‖ 11 ‖
t.hk:
tatrottamA rUpasaMpat satsthitiprabhAvasukhadyutilezyAyogo vizuddhendriyavidhitvaM prakRSTAni bhogasAdhanAni divyo vimAnanivaho manoharANyudyAtrAni ramyA jalAzayAH kAntA apsaraso-
'tinipuNAH kiMkarAH pragalbho nATyavidhizcaturodArA bhogAH sadA cittAhlAdo'nekasukhahetutvaM kuzalAnubandho mahAkalyANapUjAkaraNaM taurthakarasevA saddharmazrutau ratiH sadA sukhitvam ‖ 11 ‖

t.deva: तच्च्युतावपि विशिष्टे देशे विशिष्ट एव काले स्फीते महाकुले निष्कलङ्केन्वयेनोदग्रे सदाचारेणाख्यायिकापुरुषयुक्तेऽनेकमनोरथापूरकमत्यन्तनिरवद्यं जन्म॥१२॥
t.iast: taccyutāvapi viśiṣṭe deśe viśiṣṭa eva kāle sphīte mahākule niṣkalaṅkenvayenodagre sadācāreṇākhyāyikāpuruṣayukte'nekamanorathāpūrakamatyantaniravadyaṃ janma ‖ 12 ‖
t.iso: taccyutāvapi viśiṣṭē dēśē viśiṣṭa ēva kālē sphītē mahākulē niṣkalaṅkēnvayēnōdagrē sadācārēṇākhyāyikāpuruṣayuktē’nēkamanōrathāpūrakamatyantaniravadyaṁ janma ‖ 12 ‖
t.hk: taccyutAvapi viziSTe deze viziSTa eva kAle sphIte mahAkule niSkalaGkenvayenodagre sadAcAreNAkhyAyikApuruSayukte'nekamanorathApUrakamatyantaniravadyaM janma ‖ 12 ‖

t.deva: सुन्दरं रूपमालयो लक्षणानां रहिताममयेन युक्तं प्रज्ञया सगतं कलाकलापयेन॥१३॥
t.iast: sundaraṃ rūpamālayo lakṣaṇānāṃ rahitāmamayena yuktaṃ prajñayā sagataṃ kalākalāpayena ‖ 13 ‖
t.iso: sundaraṁ rūpamālayō lakṣaṇānāṁ rahitāmamayēna yuktaṁ prajñayā sagataṁ kalākalāpayēna ‖ 13 ‖
t.hk: sundaraM rUpamAlayo lakSaNAnAM rahitAmamayena yuktaM prajJayA sagataM kalAkalApayena ‖ 13 ‖

t.deva:
गुणपक्षपातोऽसदाचारभीरुता कल्याणमित्रयोगः सत्कथाश्रवणं मार्गानुगो बोधः सर्वाः-
चितप्राप्तिर्हिताय सत्त्वसंघातस्य परितोषकरी गुरूणां संवर्धनी गुणीन्तरस्य निदर्शनं जनानाम् अत्युदार आशयोऽसाधारणा विषया रहिताः संक्लेशेनापरोपतापिनोऽमङ्गुलावसानाः॥१४॥
t.iast:
guṇapakṣapāto'sadācārabhīrutā kalyāṇamitrayogaḥ satkathāśravaṇaṃ mārgānugo bodhaḥ sarvāḥ-
citaprāptirhitāya sattvasaṃghātasya paritoṣakarī gurūṇāṃ saṃvardhanī guṇīntarasya nidarśanaṃ janānām atyudāra āśayo'sādhāraṇā viṣayā rahitāḥ saṃkleśenāparopatāpino'maṅgulāvasānāḥ ‖ 14 ‖
t.iso:
guṇapakṣapātō’sadācārabhīrutā kalyāṇamitrayōgaḥ satkathāśravaṇaṁ mārgānugō bōdhaḥ sarvāḥ-
citaprāptirhitāya sattvasaṁghātasya paritōṣakarī gurūṇāṁ saṁvardhanī guṇīntarasya nidarśanaṁ janānām atyudāra āśayō’sādhāraṇā viṣayā rahitāḥ saṁklēśēnāparōpatāpinō’maṅgulāvasānāḥ ‖ 14 ‖
t.hk:
guNapakSapAto'sadAcArabhIrutA kalyANamitrayogaH satkathAzravaNaM mArgAnugo bodhaH sarvAH-
citaprAptirhitAya sattvasaMghAtasya paritoSakarI gurUNAM saMvardhanI guNIntarasya nidarzanaM janAnAm atyudAra Azayo'sAdhAraNA viSayA rahitAH saMklezenAparopatApino'maGgulAvasAnAH ‖ 14 ‖

t.deva: तच्च्युतावपि विशिष्टदेश इत्यादि इत्यादि समानं पूर्वेण॥२५॥
t.iast: taccyutāvapi viśiṣṭadeśa ityādi ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ‖ 25 ‖
t.iso: taccyutāvapi viśiṣṭadēśa ityādi ityādi samānaṁ pūrvēṇa ‖ 25 ‖
t.hk: taccyutAvapi viziSTadeza ityAdi ityAdi samAnaM pUrveNa ‖ 25 ‖

t.deva: अशुभपरिणाम एव हि प्रधानं बन्धकारणं तदङ्गतया तु बाह्यम्॥३३॥
t.iast: aśubhapariṇāma eva hi pradhānaṃ bandhakāraṇaṃ tadaṅgatayā tu bāhyam ‖ 33 ‖
t.iso: aśubhapariṇāma ēva hi pradhānaṁ bandhakāraṇaṁ tadaṅgatayā tu bāhyam ‖ 33 ‖
t.hk: azubhapariNAma eva hi pradhAnaM bandhakAraNaM tadaGgatayA tu bAhyam ‖ 33 ‖

var: Numbering jumps from 35 to 37 in the edition

t.deva:
यत्किंचन शुभं लोके स्थानं तत्सर्वमेव हि।
अनुबन्धगुणोपेतं धर्मादाप्नोति मानवः॥४२॥
t.iast:
yatkiṃcana śubhaṃ loke sthānaṃ tatsarvameva hi |
anubandhaguṇopetaṃ dharmādāpnoti mānavaḥ ‖ 42 ‖
t.iso:
yatkiṁcana śubhaṁ lōkē sthānaṁ tatsarvamēva hi |
anubandhaguṇōpētaṁ dharmādāpnōti mānavaḥ ‖ 42 ‖
t.hk:
yatkiMcana zubhaM loke sthAnaM tatsarvameva hi |
anubandhaguNopetaM dharmAdApnoti mAnavaH ‖ 42 ‖

t.deva:
धर्मश्चिन्तामणिः श्रेष्ठो धर्मः कल्याणमुत्तमम्।
हित एकान्ततो धर्मो धर्म एवामृतं परम्॥४३॥
t.iast:
dharmaścintāmaṇiḥ śreṣṭho dharmaḥ kalyāṇamuttamam |
hita ekāntato dharmo dharma evāmṛtaṃ param ‖ 43 ‖
t.iso:
dharmaścintāmaṇiḥ śrēṣṭhō dharmaḥ kalyāṇamuttamam |
hita ēkāntatō dharmō dharma ēvāmr̥taṁ param ‖ 43 ‖
t.hk:
dharmazcintAmaNiH zreSTho dharmaH kalyANamuttamam |
hita ekAntato dharmo dharma evAmRtaM param ‖ 43 ‖

colophon.deva: इति श्रीमुनिचन्द्रसूरिविरचितायां धर्मबिन्दुप्रकरणवृत्तौ विशेषतो धर्मफलविधिरष्टमोऽध्यायः समाप्तः॥
colophon.iast: iti śrīmunicandrasūriviracitāyāṃ dharmabinduprakaraṇavṛttau viśeṣato dharmaphalavidhiraṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ‖

t.deva:
किं चेह बहुनोक्तेन तौर्थकृत्त्वं जगद्धितम्।
परिशुद्धादवाप्नोति धर्माभ्यासान्नरोत्तमः॥१॥
t.iast:
kiṃ ceha bahunoktena taurthakṛttvaṃ jagaddhitam |
pariśuddhādavāpnoti dharmābhyāsānnarottamaḥ ‖ 1 ‖
t.iso:
kiṁ cēha bahunōktēna taurthakr̥ttvaṁ jagaddhitam |
pariśuddhādavāpnōti dharmābhyāsānnarōttamaḥ ‖ 1 ‖
t.hk:
kiM ceha bahunoktena taurthakRttvaM jagaddhitam |
parizuddhAdavApnoti dharmAbhyAsAnnarottamaH ‖ 1 ‖

t.deva:
नातः परं जगत्यस्मिन्विद्यते स्थानमुत्तमम्।
तीर्थकृत्त्वं यथा सम्यक् स्वपरार्थप्रसाधकम्॥२॥
t.iast:
nātaḥ paraṃ jagatyasminvidyate sthānamuttamam |
tīrthakṛttvaṃ yathā samyak svaparārthaprasādhakam ‖ 2 ‖
t.iso:
nātaḥ paraṁ jagatyasminvidyatē sthānamuttamam |
tīrthakr̥ttvaṁ yathā samyak svaparārthaprasādhakam ‖ 2 ‖
t.hk:
nAtaH paraM jagatyasminvidyate sthAnamuttamam |
tIrthakRttvaM yathA samyak svaparArthaprasAdhakam ‖ 2 ‖

t.deva:
पञ्चस्वपि महाकल्याणेषु त्रैलोक्यशङ्करम्।
तथैव स्वार्थसंसिद्ध्या परं निर्वाणकारणम्॥३॥
t.iast:
pañcasvapi mahākalyāṇeṣu trailokyaśaṅkaram |
tathaiva svārthasaṃsiddhyā paraṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam ‖ 3 ‖
t.iso:
pañcasvapi mahākalyāṇēṣu trailōkyaśaṅkaram |
tathaiva svārthasaṁsiddhyā paraṁ nirvāṇakāraṇam ‖ 3 ‖
t.hk:
paJcasvapi mahAkalyANeSu trailokyazaGkaram |
tathaiva svArthasaMsiddhyA paraM nirvANakAraNam ‖ 3 ‖

t.deva: तच्च सुखपरंपरया प्रकृष्टभावशुद्धेः सामान्यचरमजन्म तथा तीर्थकृत्त्वं च॥५॥
t.iast: tacca sukhaparaṃparayā prakṛṣṭabhāvaśuddheḥ sāmānyacaramajanma tathā tīrthakṛttvaṃ ca ‖ 5 ‖
t.iso: tacca sukhaparaṁparayā prakr̥ṣṭabhāvaśuddhēḥ sāmānyacaramajanma tathā tīrthakr̥ttvaṁ ca ‖ 5 ‖
t.hk: tacca sukhaparaMparayA prakRSTabhAvazuddheH sAmAnyacaramajanma tathA tIrthakRttvaM ca ‖ 5 ‖

t.deva: तत्राक्लिष्टमनुत्तरं विषयसौख्यं हीनभावविगम उदग्रतरा संपत् प्रभूतोपकारकरणम् आशयविशुद्धिर्धर्मप्रधानता अवन्ध्यक्रियात्वम्॥६॥
t.iast: tatrākliṣṭamanuttaraṃ viṣayasaukhyaṃ hīnabhāvavigama udagratarā saṃpat prabhūtopakārakaraṇam āśayaviśuddhirdharmapradhānatā avandhyakriyātvam ‖ 6 ‖
t.iso: tatrākliṣṭamanuttaraṁ viṣayasaukhyaṁ hīnabhāvavigama udagratarā saṁpat prabhūtōpakārakaraṇam āśayaviśuddhirdharmapradhānatā avandhyakriyātvam ‖ 6 ‖
t.hk: tatrAkliSTamanuttaraM viSayasaukhyaM hInabhAvavigama udagratarA saMpat prabhUtopakArakaraNam AzayavizuddhirdharmapradhAnatA avandhyakriyAtvam ‖ 6 ‖

t.deva:
संनिपातमेव व्याचष्टे।
रागद्वेषमोहा हि दोषास्तथा तथात्मदूषणात्॥११॥
t.iast:
saṃnipātameva vyācaṣṭe |
rāgadveṣamohā hi doṣāstathā tathātmadūṣaṇāt ‖ 11 ‖
t.iso:
saṁnipātamēva vyācaṣṭē |
rāgadvēṣamōhā hi dōṣāstathā tathātmadūṣaṇāt ‖ 11 ‖
t.hk:
saMnipAtameva vyAcaSTe |
rAgadveSamohA hi doSAstathA tathAtmadUSaNAt ‖ 11 ‖

t.deva:
अथैतेषां भावसंनिपातत्वं समर्थयन्नाह।
सत्स्वेतेषु न यथावस्थितं सुखं स्वधातुवैषम्यात्॥१५॥
t.iast:
athaiteṣāṃ bhāvasaṃnipātatvaṃ samarthayannāha |
satsveteṣu na yathāvasthitaṃ sukhaṃ svadhātuvaiṣamyāt ‖ 15 ‖
t.iso:
athaitēṣāṁ bhāvasaṁnipātatvaṁ samarthayannāha |
satsvētēṣu na yathāvasthitaṁ sukhaṁ svadhātuvaiṣamyāt ‖ 15 ‖
t.hk:
athaiteSAM bhAvasaMnipAtatvaM samarthayannAha |
satsveteSu na yathAvasthitaM sukhaM svadhAtuvaiSamyAt ‖ 15 ‖

t.deva:
ननु क्रियमाणत्वेन कर्मण आदिमत्त्वप्रसङ्गेन कथं सर्वकालं कर्मबत् एव तद्ग्रह इत्याशंक्याह।
तदनादित्वेन तथाभावसिद्धेः॥३६॥
t.iast:
nanu kriyamāṇatvena karmaṇa ādimattvaprasaṅgena kathaṃ sarvakālaṃ karmabat eva tadgraha ityāśaṃkyāha |
tadanāditvena tathābhāvasiddheḥ ‖ 36 ‖
t.iso:
nanu kriyamāṇatvēna karmaṇa ādimattvaprasaṅgēna kathaṁ sarvakālaṁ karmabat ēva tadgraha ityāśaṁkyāha |
tadanāditvēna tathābhāvasiddhēḥ ‖ 36 ‖
t.hk:
nanu kriyamANatvena karmaNa AdimattvaprasaGgena kathaM sarvakAlaM karmabat eva tadgraha ityAzaMkyAha |
tadanAditvena tathAbhAvasiddheH ‖ 36 ‖

t.deva: भावसारे हि प्रवृत्त्यप्रवृत्ती सर्वत्र प्रधानो व्यवहारः॥५२॥
t.iast: bhāvasāre hi pravṛttyapravṛttī sarvatra pradhāno vyavahāraḥ ‖ 52 ‖
t.iso: bhāvasārē hi pravr̥ttyapravr̥ttī sarvatra pradhānō vyavahāraḥ ‖ 52 ‖
t.hk: bhAvasAre hi pravRttyapravRttI sarvatra pradhAno vyavahAraH ‖ 52 ‖

t.deva:
आकाशेनापि सह तस्य संबन्धं निराकुर्वन्नाह।
अतोऽकामत्वात्तत्स्वभावत्वान्न लोकान्तक्षेत्राप्तिराप्तिः॥६०॥
t.iast:
ākāśenāpi saha tasya saṃbandhaṃ nirākurvannāha |
ato'kāmatvāttatsvabhāvatvānna lokāntakṣetrāptirāptiḥ ‖ 60 ‖
t.iso:
ākāśēnāpi saha tasya saṁbandhaṁ nirākurvannāha |
atō’kāmatvāttatsvabhāvatvānna lōkāntakṣētrāptirāptiḥ ‖ 60 ‖
t.hk:
AkAzenApi saha tasya saMbandhaM nirAkurvannAha |
ato'kAmatvAttatsvabhAvatvAnna lokAntakSetrAptirAptiH ‖ 60 ‖

t.deva:
सद्ध्यानवहिना जीवो दग्ध्वा कर्मेन्धनं भुवि।
सद्ब्रह्मादिपदैर्गीतं स याति परमं पदम्॥६५॥
t.iast:
saddhyānavahinā jīvo dagdhvā karmendhanaṃ bhuvi |
sadbrahmādipadairgītaṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam ‖ 65 ‖
t.iso:
saddhyānavahinā jīvō dagdhvā karmēndhanaṁ bhuvi |
sadbrahmādipadairgītaṁ sa yāti paramaṁ padam ‖ 65 ‖
t.hk:
saddhyAnavahinA jIvo dagdhvA karmendhanaM bhuvi |
sadbrahmAdipadairgItaM sa yAti paramaM padam ‖ 65 ‖

t.deva:
नाविःकर्तुमुदारतां निजधियो वाचां न वा चातुरी-
मन्येनापि च कारणेन न कृता वृत्तिर्मयासौ परम्।
तत्त्वाभ्यासरसादुपात्तसुकृतोऽन्यत्रापि जन्मन्यहं
सर्वादीनवहानितोऽमलमना भूयासमुच्चैरिति॥
t.iast:
nāviḥkartumudāratāṃ nijadhiyo vācāṃ na vā cāturī-
manyenāpi ca kāraṇena na kṛtā vṛttirmayāsau param |
tattvābhyāsarasādupāttasukṛto'nyatrāpi janmanyahaṃ
sarvādīnavahānito'malamanā bhūyāsamuccairiti ‖
t.iso:
nāviḥkartumudāratāṁ nijadhiyō vācāṁ na vā cāturī-
manyēnāpi ca kāraṇēna na kr̥tā vr̥ttirmayāsau param |
tattvābhyāsarasādupāttasukr̥tō’nyatrāpi janmanyahaṁ
sarvādīnavahānitō’malamanā bhūyāsamuccairiti ‖
t.hk:
nAviHkartumudAratAM nijadhiyo vAcAM na vA cAturI-
manyenApi ca kAraNena na kRtA vRttirmayAsau param |
tattvAbhyAsarasAdupAttasukRto'nyatrApi janmanyahaM
sarvAdInavahAnito'malamanA bhUyAsamuccairiti ‖

t.deva:
प्रत्यक्षरं निरूप्यास्या ग्रन्थमानं विनिश्चितम्।
अनुष्टुभां सहस्राणि त्रीणि पूर्णानि बुध्यताम्॥
t.iast:
pratyakṣaraṃ nirūpyāsyā granthamānaṃ viniścitam |
anuṣṭubhāṃ sahasrāṇi trīṇi pūrṇāni budhyatām ‖
t.iso:
pratyakṣaraṁ nirūpyāsyā granthamānaṁ viniścitam |
anuṣṭubhāṁ sahasrāṇi trīṇi pūrṇāni budhyatām ‖
t.hk:
pratyakSaraM nirUpyAsyA granthamAnaM vinizcitam |
anuSTubhAM sahasrANi trINi pUrNAni budhyatAm ‖
